abilities.name: Divine Marksmanship
_curatorNotes: N1 has two hitmarks (frames 17 and 27); N4 has two hitmarks (frames 15 and 28). One hits[] entry per notation step; swap/N sourced from the last hitmark of each (per recipe multi-hitmark rule).

N (ActionAttack) is not explicitly assigned in gcsim attackFrames[] for any hit — values are the second arg to InitNormalCancelSlice (AnimationLength / N-chain cancel). Recorded per Amber calibration convention.

plunge.go defines only highPlungeFrames (no lowPlungeFrames). High plunge is gated behind hold E: gcsim enforces 'last action must be hold skill' (Venti rides wind into the air after Hold E). plungeFrames sourced from highPlungeFrames. gcsim comment: 'TODO: missing counts for plunge cancels? using hitmark as placeholder' — all cancel keys equal AnimationLength = hitmark = 58; only swap recorded. No low plunge data exists for Venti.

[Hexerei] Fandom 'Divine Marksmanship' talent infobox, buffType=Hexerei buff field (Luna III): under Hexerei: Secret Rite, while the Stormeye is active Venti's Normal Attacks convert to enemy-piercing Windsunder Arrows dealing extra Anemo DMG along the path; NA hits extend the Stormeye duration by 1s and its CD by 0.5s, once per 0.1s, max 2 times per burst. Nothing authored: the NA conversion and the extra DMG are damage-only (constitution), and onHit-driven durationExtensions are outside the wired summon path. Caveat carries the Stormeye-duration divergence.

abilities.name: Skyward Sonnet

variants.label: Hold
_curatorNotes: Hold variant cooldownStartDelay = 34 frames (vs Press = 21 on base skill). Schema gap: AbilityVariant has no cooldownStartDelay field — reviewer to extend schema or document. From skill.go: SetCDWithDelay(ActionSkill, 900, 34).

Hold E earliest cancel in gcsim is skillHoldFrames[action.ActionHighPlunge] = 116f (CanQueueAfter = 116). ActionHighPlunge is not a standard JSON key — not recorded in frames. After Hold E, Venti is airborne; typical follow-up is a high plunge (enforced by gcsim: high_plunge requires last action = hold skill with hold != 0).
All other action keys (N, Q, D, J) fall back to InitAbilSlice default = 289 (AnimationLength) — omitted per recipe rule.

'summon' tag inherited from generator. No summons[] authored: skill deals AoE anemo hit, and per A1 passive creates a 20s upcurrent on Hold — but gcsim does not model the upcurrent (asc.go explicitly: 'A1 is not implemented and will likely never be implemented'). Reviewer to decide whether to remove tag or author upcurrent as a summon/buff.
abilities.description:
O wind upon which all hymns and songs fly, bear these earth-walkers up into the sky!

Press
Summons a Wind Domain at the opponent's location, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and launching opponents into the air.

Hold
Summons an even larger Wind Domain with Venti as the epicenter, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and launching affected opponents into the air.
After unleashing the Hold version of this ability, Venti rides the wind into the air.

Opponents hit by Skyward Sonnet will fall to the ground slowly.

abilities.name: Wind's Grand Ode
_curatorNotes: Elemental Absorption: burst absorbs one of Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro once per use (absorb check begins at 4th anemo tick, frame 178; up to (480-24*4)/18 additional checks every 18f). Adds 15 absorbed-element ticks (24f interval) after absorption. Reviewer to decide effect-row representation.

Stormeye: 20 anemo ticks at frames 106, 130, ... 562 (106+24*i for i in 0..19); snapshot at frame 104. burstStart=94 is the constant used as spawnsAt — marks when the active window opens; first damage tick is at 106f. Duration 8s from gcsim comment ('8 second duration, tick every .4 second') and 20×24f = 480f = 8s.

Burst frames: InitAbilSlice(95) with comment '// Q -> N1/CA/E/D'. ActionJump=94 and ActionSwap=93 are explicitly set. ActionAttack, ActionSkill, ActionDash are NOT explicitly assigned (all default to AnimationLength=95f) — omitted per recipe rule. Reviewer may verify whether 95f should be recorded for those keys.
cooldownStartDelay: 81 frames from SetCDWithDelay(ActionBurst, 15*60, 81) in burst.go.

[Hexerei] Fandom 'Temporal Wind's Eulogy' (Witch's Eve Rite Passive, Change History: Luna III): with 2+ Hexerei in the party, while the Stormeye is active, for 4s after a nearby active character triggers Swirl that character's DMG +50% and the Stormeye deals 135% of its original DMG. The +50% DMG buff is authored in factionBonuses (gated teamFaction hexerei >=2 + state duringSummon); the 135% Stormeye multiplier is damage-only and intentionally unauthored. Note: factionBonuses effects are currently consumed only by the capability layer (Team Builder), not by the planner's buff windows — nothing in this array renders on the timeline yet.

[Hexerei] Fandom 'Splitting Gales' constellation infobox, buffType=Hexerei buff field: under Secret Rite, 2 extra tracking arrows are also fired per Windsunder Arrow, each dealing 20% of the original arrow's DMG, once per 0.25s. Damage-only enhancement — nothing authored (constitution).

constellations.name: Breeze of Reminiscence
_curatorNotes: Migrated to onHit ability:skill 2026-05-09 (F1). gcsim c2() registered as AttackCBFunc on the skill hit (both Press and Hold variants). Physical companion effect added 2026-05-09 once Physical landed in the Element union.
Airborne portion (additional -12% RES while airborne) not modeled — gcsim's TODO marker indicates this isn't implemented upstream either.

[Hexerei] Fandom 'Breeze of Reminiscence' constellation infobox, buffType=Hexerei buff field: under Secret Rite the shred becomes a flat 'Anemo RES and Physical RES by 24% for 10s' (the airborne +12% clause is gone from the buff text). The 24% version is authored in factionBonuses with conditions all[teamFaction hexerei >=2, constellation 2].

[Hexerei] 2026-08-15: the two base -12% effects are now gated `not(teamFaction hexerei >=2)`. They previously carried NO condition, with the note that gating them off 'would erase the shred window entirely in a Hexerei team' — true at the time, because factionBonuses were not consumed by the planner. They are now (docs/faction-bonuses-round.md), so the mutual exclusion is both safe and REQUIRED: without it a Hexerei team draws the -12% and the -24% as two shred bars off one skill hit, which is not a thing that happens in game. The rule: a faction bonus that CHANGES AN EXISTING NUMBER re-authors it under a gate. Contrast C6 Storm of Defiance, whose shreds the rite leaves untouched and which therefore carry no gate.

[Hexerei] Same buff field, unauthored parts: after the burst Venti gains 'Wherever a Breeze Blows' and the skill CD is reset; a Windsunder Arrow hit has a 25% chance to grant it too. Wherever a Breeze Blows = press-skill deals 300% of original DMG, lasts 15s, consumed by the press. The 300% is damage-only. The CD reset is rotation-relevant but would be inert as a factionBonuses cdReset (not collected by the planner) — carried as a caveat instead.
constellations.caveat: Shown as 12% with the normal skill cooldown; with 2+ Hexerei in the party the drop is 24% and the burst resets the skill CD.

constellations.name: Hurricane of Freedom
constellations.caveat: Orb and particle pickup aren't simulated, so this doesn't fire on its own — toggle it on for rotations that pick up particles. With 2+ Hexerei in the party it fires from the skill or burst instead, and also buffs the active character.
_curatorNotes: Stub-with-caveat (decided 2026-05-14, onParticleReceived category): manual trigger preserved because particle pickup is non-deterministic in the planner (out-of-scope per tool constitution). gcsim source: event.OnParticleReceived gated on c.Core.Player.Active() == c.Index() — fires when ANY elemental orb/particle is caught by Venti on-field. Re-evaluate only if particle-gen modelling ever enters scope (unlikely).

[Hexerei] Fandom 'Hurricane of Freedom' constellation infobox, buffType=Hexerei buff field: under Secret Rite the trigger changes from orb/particle pickup to 'After unleashing his Elemental Skill Skyward Sonnet or Elemental Burst Wind's Grand Ode, Venti and his own active party members gain a 25% Anemo DMG Bonus for 10s.' Authored in factionBonuses as two onCast effects (skill, burst) with conditions all[teamFaction hexerei >=2, constellation 4], target ['self','active'] — 'his own active party members' read as the active character, mirroring the Fischl Secret Rite target shape.

[Hexerei] 2026-08-15: the base manual-trigger effect is now gated `not(teamFaction hexerei >=2)`. The rite REPLACES the trigger (orb/particle pickup becomes a skill/burst cast), it does not add a second buff — so once factionBonuses render (docs/faction-bonuses-round.md), leaving the toggle available in a Hexerei team would let a reader stack a manual 25% on top of the automatic 25% that already fires. Below 2 Hexerei the toggle is unchanged and is still the only way this buff appears.

[A7] Original user text noted the C4 buff fires only while Venti is active on-field at pickup; dropped from the rewrite as a minor nuance since the buff is a manual toggle regardless of on-field state. Already documented in the existing curator notes (gcsim OnParticleReceived gated on Active()==Index).

constellations.name: Storm of Defiance
_curatorNotes: Migrated to onHit ability:burst, 10s 2026-05-09 (F1). gcsim c6() runs as AttackCBFunc on every burst tick hit. Duration 10s matches NewBaseWithHitlag (600f).

Second effect (absorbed-element resShred): the element field is intentionally absent because absorption is runtime-dynamic. Effect over-renders as a generic -20% resShred when no absorption occurred — element-conditional gating is a G dependency.

[Hexerei] Fandom 'Storm of Defiance' constellation infobox, buffType=Hexerei buff field: the two RES shreds are UNCHANGED under Secret Rite (-20% Anemo, -20% absorbed element) — the existing effects stand as authored. The buff field adds only 'the DMG Venti deals to these opponents will gain a CRIT DMG Bonus of 100%'. Not authored: it boosts Venti's own hits only, is tied to the enemy debuff rather than a stated duration, and inventing one would fake timing.
